sentences.text: Social worker Tom Ashby from the adult team at Coldmere conducted the assessment after a phone call.
Ronald Keegan (referred to as 'Ron') is the person being assessed.
Lisa Keegan, Ronald's daughter, was present during the assessment.
The assessment was triggered by a request from the hospital following Ronald's fall.
Ronald reported feeling 'stiff' and that his hip is sore when going up stairs.
Ronald stated he goes up the stairs 'on his backside some nights'.
Ronald reported there is only one handrail on the stairs.
Ronald stated he cannot get into the bath since the fall.
Ronald stated he has a 'strip wash' (shower) but cannot bathe.
Ronald stated he microwaves dinners.
Ronald stated his wife, Pat, cooked all the meals previously.
Ronald stated Pat was his wife for forty-six years.
Ronald stated Pat died last March.
Ronald stated he watches 'The Racing' on television.
Ronald previously attended the British Legion on Fridays but stated he has not bothered lately.
Ronald stated he likes a drink and will not lie about it.
Ronald stated he drinks 'a couple of cans' of an evening.
Ronald stated he drinks 'a couple of cans' with his tea.
Lisa stated Ronald drinks eight cans a day of the 'big ones, the strong lager'.
Lisa stated there is vodka involved, specifically a bottle obtained from Spar that is gone in two days.
Lisa stated she sees the empty cans in the bin every Sunday and has counted them as eight cans a day.
Ronald stated he is not drunk and claims he is not hurting anybody.
Ronald stated he tripped on a mat.
Lisa stated Ronald had been drinking since dinner time.
Lisa stated she found Ronald in the morning after he had fallen in the kitchen.
Lisa stated Ronald was on the floor all night after the fall and could not get up.
Lisa stated this was not the first time Ronald had fallen.
Lisa stated Ronald fell in the hall in the summer after having a drink.
Ronald stated the previous fall was on the step.
Lisa stated Mrs Okafor next door told her she saw Ronald driving to the Co-op after he had had a drink.
